properties.name: Trim the foundations description and reclassify a find_tools query to restore ranking
properties.rationale: BM25 document length normalization penalises each matching term when a document grows. A tool's NAME matches score 5x a description match; no description wording can outweigh a name match. The fix is two-part: keep the description short, and classify queries honestly by whether another tool's name carries the query's key word. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: The foundations walk's ~40-word get_node description diluted BM25 per-term scores, dropping get_node out of first place for 3 of 10 queries. Fix: trimmed description to 11 words; moved 'pull up the full record for a requirement' from GET_NODE_FIRST to GET_NODE_FOUND because set_requirement_lineage owns 'requirement' in its NAME (5x weight).
